GW-R.reason: No independent absolute recharge/water-balance tolerance with sufficient temporal semantics.

GW-D.reason: No independent exchange/reversal/head-consequence tolerance and no portable flux-to-head mapping.

SCI-P.reason: Available soil-moisture requirements are measurement/product or empirical model-performance criteria, not process-research fidelity authority.

cost_interpretation: COST1 shared-host screening remains preserved but cannot be promoted to computational value for any purpose because no candidate is purpose-admissible yet.
allowed_next: Obtain a purpose-owner requirement that defines acceptable prediction consequence and temporal scale before candidate exposure.
Or obtain an external standard or decision rule that directly defines the missing purpose-specific tolerance.

For GW-R/GW-D, an authorized groundwater response mapping may convert a decision-specific head/flow consequence into a recharge/exchange envelope if the mapping is independently defined before Layer-ROM response exposure.
prohibited_next: Do not infer thresholds from current L4/L6/R8 errors.
Do not use generic numerical water-balance closure as GW-R tolerance.
Do not use sensor or satellite soil-moisture accuracy as SCI-P tolerance without an independently justified application mapping.
Do not run blind validation merely to see what threshold would be convenient.
